_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/test-2029-module-boundary.mjs. Entries may only be REMOVED (as coupling is eliminated); a new coupling fails the test. class: L=Legacy-owned, N=needs 2029-owned replacement, I=neutral shared infrastructure, F=shared functionality (split logic/UI). No automatic baseline update.

src/components/EmailVerify.jsx.action: OTP UI; reached via WatchButton/SubscribeGate. Auth2029Page exists; remove from 2029 path after WatchButton split.

src/components/MaintenanceLock.jsx.action: Split: feature-state resolver (site_flags, public-reading lock) → neutral service; Legacy keeps the mlock UI (heritage logo, inline styles); 2029 closed-state UI already exists in App2029 FramedGate2029.

src/components/PostFollowBox.jsx.action: Composition of WatchButton with Legacy defaults; follows WatchButton split.
